papers.name: Elementary Structural Geology

syllabus.topics: An introduction to various planar and linear geological structures, including the concepts of outcrop, and strike-dip. Detailed examination of the clinometer compass and its application in the field. Analysis of how topography influences outcrop patterns, with a focus on the application of rule of ‘V’s.

Definition and identification of the components of folds along with the geometrical classification of folds and methods for recognizing folds in the field. Discussion on the causes of folding and its geological significance.

Definition and classification of various types of unconformities. Introduction to the concepts of overlap, onlap, offlap, overstep, outlier, and inlier. Methods for recognizing unconformities in the field and discussion of their geological significance.

Definition and detailed description of the components of faults and joints, with a focus on their geometric and genetic classification. Exploration of the effects of faulting on outcrops and the characteristic features that indicate faulting in the field. Examination of the causes and significance of faulting, with an emphasis on structures such as horst and graben, autochthon, allochothon, window, and klippe. Analysis of the characteristics of fractures and joints, including different fracture modes and their implications in geological studies.
